summary: Fit care sheets to their content, bound iPad forms, render long sheet lists lazily, scale Growth values, keep category colors and accessible selections consistent, anchor delete confirmation below its button, and preserve bottle amounts on refocus. Cache care rows, child selection and minute summaries until data changes, and limit history filtering to visible rows plus one lookahead record; make sheet handoffs follow native dismissal. Run large-history and control benchmarks together with XCTest's recommended sample count, retain the full native suite and hosted ratio limit, and enforce the local CPU limit on the worst recorded sample. Treat an unstable hosted control as inconclusive and repeat only the benchmark pair once, without retrying stable performance failures.
